messages:
Maya S: thinking aloud — can we add a "preview" dry_run to runtime-config API so PMs can simulate rollouts without touching live counters?
Andrew P: need to define scope. simulate routing + quota accounting + cost estimate?
Maya S: yes. produce a report of decisions + cost delta + safety flags. include a safepoint id to reproduce later.
Lucas R: technically we can run the full resolver in read-only mode and sample traffic. overhead ~ evaluator CPU proportional to sample_rate.
Tiago N: API sketch: {"config":..., "dry_run":true, "sample_rate":0.02, "safepoint_id":"sp-2026-03-21-a"}
Kim (SRE): preview must not increment production counters or affect autoscaling/billing. write ephemeral metrics only.
Andrew P: reuse existing eval path but add a no-persist mode. must confirm no side effects.
Lucas R: console should show route diffs, estimated p50/p95 latency shift, projected token burn, and cohort overlap viz.
Maya S: add quick actions: convert preview -> rollout, and create rollback from preview snapshot.
Kim (SRE): defaults: sample_rate <= 0.05, safepoint TTL 7d. alert on threshold breaches; ops notified.
ops-bot: I can post an alert to #eng-oncall when preview crosses thresholds; will include preview_id and link.
Tiago N: I'll prototype snapshot runner that consumes a replica stream for sampled requests and returns a JSON report.
Andrew P: assign: Tiago 2w prototype, Lucas 1w console mock, Kim 3d policy doc. I'll check evaluator deps.
Maya S: nice. please avoid logging full config blobs. audit events should only include metadata (user, tenant, sample_rate, safepoint).
Lucas R: UI mock will include "simulate cost impact" checkbox visible to finance role only.
Maya S: will update the RFC and ping this thread with link.
